package.description: Free, open-source VALORANT-style aim, movement and utility trainer.

en-US.description: Free, open-source VALORANT-style aim, movement and utility trainer.
en-US.longDescription:
ValTrainer is a free, offline practice range in the style of VALORANT. It offers aim drills, movement and
utility practice, bots tuned to rank-based difficulty tiers, a sensitivity finder and an aim coach that
reviews every run. It can read your VALORANT sensitivity, crosshair, keybinds and video settings from your
config files, so practice feels like the game. It never touches the game process.
ValTrainer is a fan project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Riot Games.
en-US.name: ValTrainer
en-US.releaseNotes:
Added
- Gun skins (suggested on Discord): 15 original skin lines made for ValTrainer, in three tiers:
  - Core (5 lines, free from the start): Carbon Weave, Desert Camo, Anodized Teal, Damascus Steel and Two-Tone Polymer. A finish only.
  - Signature (7 lines): Glasswork, Thunderhead, Basalt, Oscilloscope, Rally, Frostbite and Hive. One level with everything except animation, a finisher and a special reload: the skin's own gun sounds, hit and headshot sounds, kill sounds, muzzle flash, tracers and impacts, a kill effect, a kill banner and an inspect flourish.
  - Apex (Foundry, Aurora, Orrery): 5 levels and 3 colour variants each. Level 2 animates the finish, level 3 adds the sounds and effects, level 4 an inspect flourish, a special reload and a kill banner, and level 5 a finisher and a kill counter on the gun. On the Vandal and Phantom the Apex skins are detailed 3D models of their own, held and framed like in VALORANT.
    Open the collection from SKINS on the main menu, the gun picker, Settings → General, or K in a drill's preview. Each line has a level track, its variants and what you need to unlock each part; TURNTABLE, IN HAND and SHOWCASE (a small range where a dummy is shot) preview it, with INSPECT (Y) and RELOAD (R). Pick a skin, level and variant per gun or for every gun. Settings → SKIN EFFECTS turns skin sounds, kill effects (off / gun only / full), finishers and the kill counter on or off and sets their volume; Classic hit sounds keeps the factory body and headshot sounds on every skin. Kill effects and finishers only play for your own kills during a run, and finishers follow VALORANT's rule: only on the kill that wins the round (Retake and the other round-based drills). Skins are cosmetic: bots, scores, stats and replays aren't affected. They're not VALORANT skins: Riot's skins, sounds and effects can't be used.
- Inspect your gun (press Y, rebindable on the KEYBINDS tab), like in VALORANT. Firing, aiming, reloading, switching or sprinting cancels it. Skins with an inspect flourish add their own effect and sound.
- Supporter codes: as a thank-you, people who donate on Ko-fi or Buy Me a Coffee get every skin, level and variant at once, including skins added later. In Settings → About → Get my code, enter the email you donated with and press GET (or paste a code you were given). Codes are checked offline; skins can still be earned by playing.
- Progression (to make training count): your training earns XP and levels, and stars for real improvement (new personal bests and badge rank-ups). Three daily and three weekly challenges come with one reroll a day. A weekly streak has rest tokens, so missing a week doesn't reset it. Levels, stars and coach rank-ups unlock the skins. Signature and Apex skins need real improvement, not just time: the higher Apex levels also need badge and coach rank-ups. The main menu shows your level, XP and today's challenges, and a new Progress screen shows challenges, your streak, the next unlocks and the level track. The results screen shows the XP a run earned and why. The training you've already done counts: on the first start, ValTrainer credits your past runs, PBs, badges and Lock-Ins. Progression only reads your runs; it never changes scores.
- Crosshair switcher (suggested on Discord): scroll through all the crosshair profiles saved in your VALORANT, plus crosshair codes you save in ValTrainer, like in the game. Use ◀ ▶ (or the mouse wheel over the preview) on the main menu, the pause menu and Settings, or press , and . in a drill (change them on the KEYBINDS tab). Settings can now keep up to 20 crosshair codes: paste a code to add it, then rename, copy, reorder or delete it. Nothing changes until you pick a different crosshair. ValTrainer reads the profiles VALORANT last saved on this PC; if your profiles live only in Riot's cloud, you'll see just your current crosshair.
- A short Sens Finder test (suggested on Discord): press Q on its start screen to switch to a test that takes about half the time (3 steps and lighter rounds instead of 5). It runs the same blind A/B rounds, with a slightly wider margin on the result. ValTrainer remembers your choice.
- Languages (suggested on Discord): ValTrainer is now in English, French, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil) and German. Pick one at the top of Settings → General, or leave it on Auto to follow your VALORANT language. The translations are machine-made for now; corrections are welcome (see CONTRIBUTING.md).
Fixed
- The coach's rank estimate was too high (reported by a player). Easy drills inflated it: crosshair placement now counts each drill's own conditions (peek and jiggle drills no longer count as perfect placement), movement habits only come from drills that don't tell you how to move, the spray tables are stricter, and the estimate leans on your core aim skills. The likely range is wider and says how much data it's based on, and the coach notes that it rates aim only: your rank also depends on game sense, utility and teamwork. You can now enter your VALORANT rank on the Profile screen to see whether your aim is ahead of or behind it and what to train. Your rank stays on this PC. Players who want to help tune the coach can copy one anonymous line (rank and skill numbers, no names) to share on Discord.
- Your gun is reloaded when you respawn (reported on Discord). Before, a drill could bring you back with the magazine you died with, or mid-reload, in Strafe Duels, Peek Duels, Site Clear, Flash Dodge, Anchor, Sound Lock, Post-plant, Retake, Jump Peek, Jiggle Peek, Smoke Execute, Mobility Entry, Flash Peek and Recon. A new duel or rep in Strafe Duels, Peek Duels and Sound Lock also starts with a full magazine. Drills where reloading is part of the practice (Sheriff One-Taps, the spray drills) are unchanged.
- An accidental double-click no longer counts as a miss in Spidershot, Gridshot and Head Flicks (reported on Discord). A shot within 150 ms of a hit, too soon to be aimed at the next target, is ignored when it misses: it doesn't lower your accuracy or score, and the coach and the Rewind leave it out. The results screen shows how many were ignored.
- The Rewind's reload bar now shows partial reloads and one-round-at-a-time reloads (Bucky, Marshal) correctly.
Download: ValTrainer-1.19.0-Setup.exe (installer, recommended) or ValTrainer-1.19.0-Portable.zip (unzip and run, no install). Windows 10 (1607+) or 11, 64-bit.
ValTrainer isn't code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may say "Windows protected your PC": click More info -> Run anyway. Check your download against SHA256SUMS.txt if you like.
